name: Xpel Argan Oil Hydrating Hair Mask 220ml
description:
Xpel Argan Oil Hydrating Hair Mask 220ml

Revive and nourish your hair with Xpel Argan Oil Hydrating Hair Mask, enriched with proteins, keratin, and Argan Oil for deep conditioning and repair.

Key Benefits:

Revitalizes Dry & Damaged Hair: Restores moisture, strength, and elasticity.

Improves Texture & Manageability: Leaves hair soft, shiny, and easy to style.

Nourishing Formula: Infused with Argan Oil to provide intense hydration and protection.

Suitable for All Hair Types: Gentle yet effective care for everyone.

Hair Type: All types
Volume: 220ml | Developed in UK, Manufactured in PRC, Imported from UK

Perfect for healthy, shiny, and manageable hair with every use.
